name: anything-llm
description: The best solution for turning private documents into a chat bot using off-the-shelf tools and commercially viable AI technologies.
author: Timothy Carambat (Mintplex Labs)

scripts.lint: cd server && corepack yarn lint && cd ../frontend && corepack yarn lint && cd ../collector && corepack yarn lint
scripts.lint:ci: cd server && corepack yarn lint:check && cd ../frontend && corepack yarn lint:check && cd ../collector && corepack yarn lint:check
scripts.setup: cd server && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../collector && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../frontend && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile && cd .. && corepack yarn setup:envs && corepack yarn prisma:setup && echo "Please run corepack yarn dev:server, corepack yarn dev:collector, and corepack yarn dev:frontend in separate terminal tabs."
scripts.setup:envs:
cp -n ./frontend/.env.example ./frontend/.env; cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development; cp -n ./collector/.env.example ./collector/.env; cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env; echo "All ENV files copied!
"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "corepack yarn dev:server" "corepack yarn dev:frontend" "corepack yarn dev:collector"
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: corepack yarn prisma:generate && corepack yarn prisma:migrate && corepack yarn prisma:seed
scripts.prisma:generate:postgres: corepack yarn prisma:prepare:postgres && cd server && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:postgres: corepack yarn prisma:prepare:postgres && cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
scripts.prisma:seed:postgres: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:setup:postgres: corepack yarn prisma:generate:postgres && corepack yarn prisma:migrate:postgres && corepack yarn prisma:seed:postgres
scripts.translations:normalize: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && cd frontend && corepack yarn lint && cd .. && corepack yarn translations:verify
scripts.translations:prune: cd frontend/src/locales && node findUnusedTranslations.mjs --delete && cd ../../../ && corepack yarn translations:normalize
